facts.text: Chris Tanev is out week-to-week with an upper-body injury, per the Maple Leafs
Tanev placed on injured reserve Monday, retroactive to Oct. 10
Tanev was hurt in the 6-3 win at Colorado, leaving at 11:08 of the first period after five shifts
Leafs were still running tests on Tanev as of Oct. 13, per TSN
Chris Johnston cited "a little more optimism" than with last season's injuries
Leafs have not placed Tanev on LTIR
Tanev has one assist in six games and is tied for team lead with 14 blocked shots
No return date or diagnosis beyond upper-body released
Nylander had one assist vs. Utah Oct. 13, primary helper on Gavin McKenna's goal at 11:01 of the third
Utah beat Toronto 5-4; McKenna extended point streak to four games
Nylander had five points including his 700th NHL point in the 6-3 win at Colorado Oct. 10
